prose: OpenAI put its Decisions API into public beta, with general availability expected in weeks. It evaluates text, images or both and returns typed answers, a probability that a condition is true, a choice from a fixed set, or a score against a rubric, about 10x faster than the Responses API, through a dedicated POST /v1/decisions endpoint. It is aimed at classifying content, routing requests and prioritising work. Only gpt-6-luna is available now.
highlights: Public beta; GA expected in coming weeks.
Returns probabilities, choices or scores, about 10x faster than Responses.
